description: Multiple ideological framings via system prompt variation (OpenRouter unavailable for free models, using Anthropic claude-haiku-4-5 with 5 explicit value system prompts).
method: Since OpenRouter free models were rate-limited, ideological variation was simulated by providing explicit value-framing system prompts to claude-haiku-4-5. Per the tier design spec, this is equivalent: 'simulate ideological variation by using explicit different value framings as system prompts'. Five framings: technocratic, progressive, libertarian, conservative, global-south-centred.

technocratic.system_prompt_summary: Prioritise scalability, government adoption, measurable ROI, technical sophistication. Deprioritise activism.

progressive.system_prompt_summary: Prioritise power redistribution, marginalised community empowerment, corporate/government accountability, worker rights, anti-surveillance, equity.

libertarian.system_prompt_summary: Prioritise individual privacy, decentralisation, freedom from government surveillance, open source, censorship resistance, self-sovereignty.

conservative.system_prompt_summary: Prioritise institutional stability, democratic accountability, national security, proven track records, established institutions, rule of law.

global_south.system_prompt_summary: Prioritise reach in Africa/Asia/Latin America, community ownership, low-resource deployment, marginalised populations, non-Western governance models.

highly_contested_projects.name: PolicyEngine
highly_contested_projects.note: Loved by technocratic/conservative, ignored by progressive framing

highly_contested_projects.name: Matrix
highly_contested_projects.note: Only ranks under libertarian framing — the ideologically purest project

highly_contested_projects.name: AlgorithmWatch
highly_contested_projects.note: Progressive's #1 but invisible to libertarian and global south framings

highly_contested_projects.name: Worker Info Exchange
highly_contested_projects.note: Only surfaces under progressive framing — most ideologically specific project

highly_contested_projects.name: Tracka
highly_contested_projects.note: High outcomes attract technocratic/conservative; global south underweights it (Nigeria is not default reference point)
